summary: Add a purely-derived, async evidence-completeness meter to the tax module. For the active firm + current FY it counts how many applicable (non-NA) obligations have their evidence "satisfied" — SaagarEvidence file count > 0 for evKey(itemId) OR a non-empty compliance evidenceRef — versus the required total, and surfaces an "X/Y have evidence" meter (with a missing-evidence drill list) on the dashboard, plus an optional per-month "Evidence" stat chip. No new localStorage key and no shell change required: it derives entirely from taxcal_v2 (STATE.compliance via getItemRecord/isItemDone/isItemNA + getVisibleItems/getMonthItems) and the existing shell SaagarEvidence IndexedDB store. Async aggregation mirrors hydrateEvidence — render a placeholder synchronously, fill after the promises resolve — with a firm/FY race guard so a slow promise from an old firm can never overwrite the new numbers.

functionsToTouch.name: NEW computeEvidenceCompleteness(scope)
functionsToTouch.change: Async helper returning Promise<{applicableTotal,doneTotal,doneSatisfied,pct,missing:[{id,name,month,cat}],hasApi}>. (1) If getActiveFirm() is null return an immediate empty result (no async, evKey firm would be '_'). (2) CAPTURE firmId=STATE.activeFirmId and fy=STATE.fyStartYear ONCE at the top and build keys as firmId+'|'+fy+'|'+id explicitly — do NOT call evKey() inside the async loop, because evKey() reads live STATE and would use the NEW firm/FY after a mid-flight switch. (3) Build the row set: iterate MONTHS (scope==='fy') or a single month name (scope='<Month>'), for each do getVisibleItems(getMonthItems(m)).filter(i=>!isItemNA(i.id)) and collect {id,name,month,cat,done:isItemDone(i.id),ref:(getItemRecord(i.id)?.evidenceRef||'').trim()}. (4) applicableTotal=rows.length; the DONE-scoped denominator doneTotal=rows.filter(done); a done row with a non-empty ref is already satisfied (skip async). (5) For done rows with empty ref, call api.count(firmId+'|'+fy+'|'+id) via evApi() (returns Promise<number>, .catch=>0, mirrors hydrateEvidence); Promise.all these. satisfied = ref-non-empty OR count>0. (6) missing = done rows that end up unsatisfied. hasApi=!!evApi(). pct = doneTotal? round(doneSatisfied/doneTotal*100):0.

functionsToTouch.name: NEW hydrateEvidenceCompleteness(scope)
functionsToTouch.change: Mirrors hydrateEvidence's fill-a-placeholder pattern + adds a race token. Bump a module-level let __evCompToken=(__evCompToken||0)+1; capture tok=__evCompToken. Call computeEvidenceCompleteness(scope).then(r=>{ if(tok!==__evCompToken) return; // a newer render/firm-switch superseded this one — drop the stale write. Then write innerHTML into the target node: for scope==='fy' the dashboard panel #ev-completeness (meter bar + 'doneSatisfied/doneTotal completed filings have evidence' + pct + a secondary line 'applicableTotal applicable obligations this FY' + a collapsible missing list); for a month scope the #ev-comp-month stat value ('doneSatisfied/doneTotal'). }).catch(()=>{}). Guard: if node missing (view switched) just return.

approach: ADDITIVE and DERIVED-ONLY — no new localStorage key, no new record field, no shell edit strictly required. Every input already exists: (a) isItemNA(id)/isItemDone(id)/getItemRecord(id) read STATE.compliance[firmId][fy][id] out of taxcal_v2 (loadState ~851); (b) getVisibleItems(getMonthItems(m)) already yields the firm-type-filtered, archive-filtered, custom-inclusive obligation set per month (2443/2540); (c) the shell SaagarEvidence store (index.html ~4897) already exposes count(itemKey)->Promise<number> (line 4951) and evApi()=window.parent.SaagarEvidence (2905) already works cross-iframe (proven by hydrateEvidence). Satisfaction rule per obligation instance: satisfied = (getItemRecord(id).evidenceRef trimmed non-empty) OR (count(firmId|fy|id) > 0). This matches confirmDone() which writes evidenceRef AND attaches files (2946/2957/2960), and evAttachHere() which can attach files independent of a ref (2914). RECOMMENDED denominator = DONE non-NA obligations across the FY (headline: 'M of N completed filings have evidence'), because evidence only meaningfully exists once an item is filed — pending/future obligations legitimately have no proof yet, so including them would keep the meter perpetually low and non-actionable and conflate 'not yet due' with 'missing proof'. ALSO surface the FY-wide applicable-obligation total as a secondary context number, and make the drill-down 'missing evidence' list = done-but-unsatisfied rows (the true audit gaps). Granularity = one row per MONTHLY obligation instance (item ids are month-scoped and each has its own evKey bucket), so a monthly filing like GSTR-3B counts once per month with its own proof — the correct audit granularity. Async: build the row set synchronously, short-circuit rows already satisfied by a non-empty evidenceRef (no IndexedDB call), and Promise.all only the count() lookups for done-without-ref rows (a small set), then write the meter into a pre-rendered placeholder — exactly the hydrateEvidence lifecycle. Capture firmId+fy at compute start and guard the DOM write with a monotonic token so a firm/FY switch mid-flight cannot paint stale numbers.
ui: Two surfaces. PRIMARY (dashboard, dash-view #dash-content): a full-width 'Evidence Pack Completeness' meter inserted after the dash-stats KPI row, reusing the module's existing .prog-wrap/.prog-bar-bg/.prog-bar-fill progress-bar styling (tax.html ~234-242) so zero new CSS. Layout: title 'Evidence Pack Completeness' + right-aligned percentage; a fill bar at pct%; a caption 'M of N completed filings have evidence attached'; a secondary muted line 'FY <label>: K applicable obligations · <NA count> not applicable'; and a collapsible/inline 'Missing evidence (Z)' list where each row shows the obligation name + month with an 'Open →' button reusing the existing pattern onclick=\"showView('calendar');setMonth('<month>')\" (as the dashboard focus/nc-item rows already do at 3032). Empty states: no firm → 'Select a firm to track evidence completeness' (mirrors the .no-firm-banner copy at 3032); zero done items → 'No completed filings yet — evidence appears here once filings are marked done'; all satisfied → green bar at 100% with 'All completed filings have evidence attached.'. Initial placeholder text 'Calculating…' shown until the async fill lands. SECONDARY/OPTIONAL (calendar month view #content): a compact 'Evidence' cell added to the existing per-month .stats strip (2985) showing that month's done-non-NA coverage as 'M/N', async-filled from '—'. Copy stays audit-neutral and factual (no advice).
edgeCases: No firm selected: getActiveFirm() null → isItemDone/getItemRecord already return false/null; compute returns an empty result and renders the 'Select a firm' state. Must NOT run the async loop (evKey firm resolves to '_', would read a bogus bucket).

evApi() null (module opened standalone / shell absent): count() unavailable. Fall back to evidenceRef-only satisfaction and set hasApi=false so the caption can note 'file counts unavailable'. Mirrors hydrateEvidence returning silently when !api (2923).
Zero done non-NA items: denominator 0 → avoid divide-by-zero; show 0% bar + 'No completed filings yet' rather than NaN.

Firm/FY switched mid-async: evKey() reads live STATE, so keys MUST be built from firmId/fy captured at compute start; the __evCompToken guard drops a superseded promise before it writes — prevents showing Firm A's numbers under Firm B.
count() promise rejects (IndexedDB hiccup): .catch=>0 per key, so the row falls back to its evidenceRef; never throws, matches hydrateEvidence's .catch at 2934.
evidenceRef is whitespace-only: treat String(ref).trim() empty as NOT satisfied so a stray space doesn't fake coverage.

Composition/unregistered/no-employee firm: getVisibleItems already hides non-applicable categories (gst/comp/payroll filters, 2452-2455) so both numerator and denominator correctly shrink to that firm's real obligation set — no special handling.
Archived obligation or archived whole category: isArchived/archivedCats filtered out by getVisibleItems (2450-2451) — excluded automatically.
Custom obligations: expandCustom flows them through getMonthItems/getVisibleItems with per-month ids and their own evKey buckets — counted automatically (2488/2540).
Past as-of browsing (isPastAsOf true): completeness is a pure READ (no writes), so it renders fine while browsing history; no read-only guard needed since it never mutates state or attaches files.

Same obligation across 12 months (monthly filings): each monthly instance is a distinct id with its own evidence bucket, so it contributes up to 12 rows — intended granularity; document so reviewers don't read it as double counting.

Re-render churn: rerender()/showView re-inject #dash-content or #content each call; a late promise writing to a now-detached #ev-completeness node is harmless (mirrors hydrateEvidence), and the token guard covers the firm-switch case specifically.
verifySteps: Load _extracted_modules/tax.html in the browser harness (top window; tax is NOT admin-gated, unlike payroll). Ensure window.parent.SaagarEvidence exists (real shell) or stub it with count()/list()/add() returning promises.

Seed taxcal_v2 with a firm + fyStartYear=2026 and a getFirmCompliance bucket where: item A done + evidenceRef='ACK123' (satisfied via ref), item B done + no ref but a file attached via SaagarEvidence.add(evKey(B),[file]) (satisfied via file), item C done + no ref + no file (MISSING), item D pending (excluded from done denominator), item E marked NA (excluded entirely).

Open the Dashboard view: assert #ev-completeness placeholder is replaced after async, the fraction reads 2/3 (A,B satisfied of A,B,C done), pct=67%, the missing list contains exactly item C with a working 'Open →' that calls showView('calendar')+setMonth(C.month).
Attach a file to item C via the card '+ Attach file' then re-open dashboard: coverage becomes 3/3, 100%, empty missing list.

Switch active firm to one with different/zero evidence and re-render: numbers recompute for the new firm with NO stale bleed from the previous firm (validates captured-key + token guard). Repeat for switchFY.
No-firm state (STATE.activeFirmId=null): dashboard shows the 'Select a firm' empty state, runs NO async, throws no console error.
evApi null (delete window.parent.SaagarEvidence and window.SaagarEvidence): meter still renders using evidenceRef-only satisfaction, notes file counts unavailable, no crash.
Optional month chip: open the calendar month owning items A-C; assert #ev-comp-month fills to that month's done-non-NA coverage.
Confirm 0 console errors across all of the above and that the meter never flashes NaN/undefined.
risks: Async race showing a previous firm's/FY's numbers — mitigated by (a) building evidence keys from firmId+fy captured at compute start rather than calling evKey() live, and (b) the __evCompToken monotonic guard that drops superseded writes.

Performance: N per-key count() IndexedDB reads on dashboard render. Bounded by short-circuiting rows already satisfied by evidenceRef and by scoping the async set to DONE-without-ref rows (typically small). Offline/single-firm datasets make this acceptable; a bulk shell counter is only an optional optimization (see open questions).

Merge collision with the other Wave-12 tax items that also edit renderMonth/renderDashboard (P1-41 statutory-payable card; P1-34 evidence ZIP export) — same big template literals and the same post-innerHTML hydrate tail. Needs sequenced insertion by the synthesis owner (see collision notes).

Denominator-definition mismatch: if synthesis prefers the literal 'over all applicable non-NA' denominator instead of the recommended done-scoped one, the meter reads lower and mixes not-yet-filed items into 'missing' — a copy/semantics change, not a structural one (see open questions).
Cosmetic: the 'Calculating…' placeholder briefly shows before the async fill on slow WebViews — acceptable, identical to the existing hydrateEvidence flash.
collisionNotes: Within tax.html, three Wave-12 items converge on the same two render functions and must be sequenced by the synthesis owner: P1-32 (this — evidence meter), P1-41 (Statutory Payable card, adds to the renderMonth month-header/card region ~2984-2994 and possibly a renderDashboard panel), and P1-34 (evidence-pack ZIP export, adds a button likely on the dashboard/month header and enumerates SaagarEvidence by firm|fy prefix). Specific shared anchors: (1) renderMonth .stats strip literal at 2985 — P1-32's optional 'Evidence' .sc cell and any P1-41 month-header addition edit adjacent regions; (2) renderMonth tail at 2996-2998 (the #content innerHTML assignment + hydrateEvidence() call) — P1-32 adds hydrateEvidenceCompleteness(month) beside the existing hydrateEvidence(); (3) renderDashboard html assembly ~3032 and the #dash-content innerHTML at 3033 — P1-32 inserts the #ev-completeness panel + a hydrate call, P1-41/P1-34 may insert their own panels/buttons here. P1-32 shares the evidence subsystem (evKey/evApi/SaagarEvidence, 2904-2905) directly with P1-34: both enumerate 'firmId|fy|*' evidence, so they should share one enumeration helper (P1-34 for the ZIP, P1-32 for the count) rather than duplicating key-walking logic. P1-33 (WA tax channel) is SHELL-side (index.html WA_CFG) — no tax.html collision. No collision with the existing hydrateEvidence/confirmDone/evAttachHere — P1-32 only READS via count()/getItemRecord and never writes evidence or state.
openQuestions: Denominator definition: RECOMMENDED = DONE non-NA obligations ('completed filings that have evidence'), with FY-wide applicable total shown as secondary context. Confirm synthesis is OK with this vs the literal 'over all applicable (non-NA)' denominator from the item text (which would count not-yet-filed items as 'missing'). This only changes copy + which rows land in the missing list, not the structure.

Scope of the meter: FY-wide on the dashboard is the recommended headline. Confirm whether the per-month .sc 'Evidence' chip is wanted too (optional, low-risk) or should be dropped to minimize the renderMonth collision surface with P1-41.

Efficiency helper: for large evidence sets, add a shared shell SaagarEvidence.countByPrefix(prefix)->Promise<{key:count}> (one cursor pass, modeled on delByMatch at 4955) that BOTH P1-32 (counts) and P1-34 (ZIP enumeration) use, instead of N per-key count() calls. This is a shell (index.html) edit owned by the orchestrator — include it or keep P1-32 self-contained with per-key count()? Recommend self-contained for P1-32 unless P1-34 already introduces the helper.

Should the existing dashboard 'Evidence readiness' ops-row (renderDashboard ~3032, currently the raw quarter done-count cq.done) be repointed to the real coverage fraction, or left untouched to reduce edit overlap? Recommend leaving it and letting the new panel own the metric.
